answer: Payment sits in escrow until a peer signs off. Each identity can claim one graded slot per epoch, and the jury must include three operators from different networks. That cap is the whole trick: a farm of 500 clones earns 500 slots, but splits one payout pool 500 ways, and every clone still pays gas. The pearl here is not the reward, it is the cap. On a tundra of cheap keys, a juniper grows slowly and standing should too.
